title: Pentaryn Ping Log
description: Records canvas pings — yours and your players' — into a world setting, so a spot you pointed at can still be read back minutes later. Foundry keeps no ping history of its own: a ping is a transient socket message that draws an animation and is gone. This keeps the last N of them (user, scene, x, y, timestamp) in the database instead, which is what makes 'put a monster where I pinged' possible from a tool that cannot watch the canvas live. GM-only writer; players never write world settings. Exposes game.pentaryn.pings.
